title: EATF AEP v1 warrant.json
description: Validates the optional warrant.json entry inside an AEP v1 evidence package (docs/specs/aep-profile-v1.md, section 4.2). A warrant is a once-authored, versioned statement that outputs a named policy evaluates to a listed decision are licensed for a listed action class, carried inside the package and referenced by digest from metadata.json. The packaged bytes MUST be the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form of this object; acceptance.signature is computed over the JCS bytes of the warrant with acceptance.signature removed. The accepting authority is a named principal with a verifiable key binding under the same self-attestation trust model as public_key.pem; nothing in this schema or profile establishes it as a legally constituted authority.

warrant_id.description: Stable identifier of the warrant. MUST match metadata.json warrant_id when that field is present.

warrant_version.description: Version string of the warrant. Versioned together with the assurance case it summarises; MUST match metadata.json warrant_version when present.

policy_ref.description: The policy this warrant is written against. MUST match the policy_id / policy_version fields of the same package's metadata.json.

inference_form.description: Free-form label for the form of inference the warrant licenses (e.g. 'policy-evaluation'). The soundness of the inference itself is attested, never machine-checked.

statement.description: Human-readable statement of the warrant, e.g. 'Outputs that policy P evaluates to allow are licensed for action class A'.

applies_to.description: The action classes and policy decisions the warrant applies to. A package whose metadata action_type or policy_decision falls outside these lists carries a warrant that does not apply: the output may inform but carries no warrant to compel.

valid_from.description: Start of the warrant validity window (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC). Freshness is judged against the package's RFC 3161 genTime.

valid_until.description: End of the warrant validity window (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC).

acceptance.description: The epistemic acceptance block: the named principal that accepted this warrant against its policy version. signature is the Base64 PKCS#1 v1.5 RSA signature (inner digest SHA-256) over the JCS bytes of the warrant with acceptance.signature removed, verifiable against public_key.

authority_id.description: Named principal identifier of the accepting authority.

accepted_at.description: When the acceptance was made (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC). Informational; the validity window governs freshness.

signature.description: Base64 (standard alphabet, with padding) acceptance signature.

public_key.description: PEM-encoded RSA public key of the accepting authority (BEGIN/END PUBLIC KEY headers).

void_if.description: Conditions that void the warrant, partitioned by kind. machine entries carry a predicate intended for machine evaluation; attested entries carry text a human must attest to. Predicate evaluation is not performed by the v0.1 verifier; the partition itself is validated so the machine/attested split stays explicit.
